verdict.rationale: FFmpeg is a multimedia tool and library suite, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an official MCP server or endpoint. The probes found no llms.txt, markdown docs or OpenAPI spec, and community reports of using LLMs to write ffmpeg commands are a user-side workaround that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
